evidence:
Built the criterion->requirement map for all 55 criteria (2 gate, 43 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual). Almost every demand traces to instruction.md or hireops_rules.md: one-stage moves (rules:47-48), bottom arrival (rules:58), reorder shared (rules:57-59), blank-reason/Hired-reject/reopen-only-to-origin/undo-restores-reason (rules:49-51,96-97), interview places & reorder-free (rules:63-65), focus on card after refusal (rules:84-85), manager late-stage limits incl. Interview->Screen and Screen reject refused (rules:70-72), recruiter-only job open/add (rules:16,28,31), 401 anonymous (rules:21), stale 409 + who (rules:77-80, instruction:3), bulk board-order arrival/all-or-none/places counted for set (rules:89-92), undo once / earlier move no longer undoable (rules:98-100), activity newest-first with reason and job filter (rules:110-113), 15 s live updates preserving focus/typing/scroll/open card (rules:117-123), Enter/Shift+Enter/empty+focused box (rules:138-140), 30-message paging with remaining count and anchored place (rules:144-147), per-person unread and scrolled-up notice (rules:151-160), seen/observer excluded (rules:164-166), drafts per person/conversation/browser incl. session end (rules:170-175, instruction:7), candidate wording table and privacy (rules:182-193), restart persistence (instruction:15). Seed check: Lena (USR-CAN3) read_count 2 of 3 APP-301 messages, third from Farah -> the '1 unread' in protocol Z/hro_unread_counts is correct. Criteria repeatedly disclaim routes/labels/layout and make hiding optional; sign-in usage is a known false positive (SKILL.md:63; Internal E28). Visual likert rows grade craft only and exclude phone/theme.

DEFECT (instance 1, blocking for this row): tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:49 protocol A says 'every successful action you performed on them in S, M, L, C, B, N and R has its line'. The only successful actions in protocol N (prompt.md:37) are note additions by Rafael and Ingrid (Ingrid's job/candidate attempts there are refused). hireops_rules.md:110 lists the recorded kinds as 'job opening, added candidate, move, rejection, reopening, re-ordering and undo' — notes are not among them, and rules:99 says 'Adding a note does not count as a change'. The golden itself records no activity for notes (solution/app/src/index.js:368-374 inserts the note and returns, no activity write). hro_activity (judge.toml:258-264) then says 'Fails if any performed action has no line'. Its colon list omits notes, but the protocol it is graded from explicitly demands lines for N's successful actions, so a literal judge can zero hro_activity for a spec-conforming app — including the reference. This is a grading demand no public requirement or professional default implies.

LOWER-RISK AMBIGUITIES (recorded, not independently blocking):
(a) hro_refused_put_back (judge.toml:131-138): an app that disables the Screen->Interview control when Interview is full (showing 'Interview full') leaves no 'page that tried' the move; unlike hro_move_one_stage/hro_reject_hired/hro_mgr_other_job it does not say hiding is optional. Rules:84-85 govern server refusals; prompt.md:23 permits replay when not offered, but the focus leg then has no UI move to anchor. Possible false fail of a conforming pre-blocking UI.
(b) hro_candidate_private (judge.toml:389) requires the replayed staff notes/card-detail read to be 'refused', whereas protocol K (prompt.md:43) also accepts 'answered with only Tomas's own data'. Rules:193 ('every staff action ... refused to candidates') makes refusal defensible, but prompt and criterion disagree.
(c) hro_pol_session_resume (polish judge.toml:59) ends the session by an explicit sign-out in a second tab; an app that deliberately purges the signing-out user's drafts on explicit sign-out would fail. Rules:172-174 say drafts survive 'after the session ends mid-reply' and instruction:7 'get signed out', so this is within the requirement; noted only.
(d) hro_reject_reason 'staff can read ... the stage it was rejected from' and hro_job_open 'appears with those values' / hro_add_candidate 'with the entered name and email': rules require the data to be kept, not displayed; judge may use browser-observed product data, reopen target or activity lines. Professional-default level; low risk.
(e) hro_pol_failed_send 'A visible explanation appears': rules:140 only require the text to stay in the box; telling the user a send failed is a professional default (and matches instruction:3's 'tell me why' spirit). Not flagged.

Runtime: raw-evidence-index.json scope states no configured judge run, Oracle or model score exists; whether the judge actually zeroes hro_activity on the golden is unmeasured.
counterexample: Conforming alternative that can fail: an app (e.g. the shipped golden, index.js:368-374) that records exactly the activity kinds in hireops_rules.md:110 and does not log note additions. The judge runs protocol N (Rafael and Ingrid add notes), then protocol A (functional prompt.md:49) requires 'every successful action ... in ... N' to have its line; it finds no note lines and, per hro_activity 'Fails if any performed action has no line', scores hro_activity 0 (weight 1) despite full compliance with the rules.
suggested_fix: In tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:49 drop N from the list of protocols whose successful actions need lines (or add 'note additions are not Activity entries'), keeping N's refused attempts covered by the 'refused attempts added no line' check; optionally state in hro_refused_put_back that a UI which disables the full-Interview move and shows the reason passes the UI leg.
